---
title: "Places I've worked and presented"
---

Conferences, fieldwork and research visits during my PhD. Click a pin for details.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(leaflet)

# Edit this table: one row per place. Find coordinates by right-clicking
# a spot in Google Maps or OpenStreetMap.
places <- data.frame(
  name  = c("Example Conference 2024", "Example Workshop 2023", "Example Field Site"),
  place = c("Lisbon, Portugal",        "Cape Town, South Africa", "Nairobi, Kenya"),
  year  = c(2024, 2023, 2022),
  type  = c("Conference", "Workshop", "Fieldwork"),
  lat   = c(38.7223, -33.9249, -1.2921),
  lng   = c(-9.1393,  18.4241, 36.8219)
)

leaflet(places) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    radius = 7, stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 0.85,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>", place, "<br>", type, ", ", year)
  )
```
